timestamp_basis: First observation clock for this approval turn, not an invented message-click timestamp.

authorization.responds_to: Do you approve these five temporary local-risk exceptions under those conditions?

conditions.C1: Exact named linux/amd64 development images only. No transfer to a rebuild, another architecture, desktop or a public candidate.
conditions.C2: Canonical Compose and entrypoint; nonzero API PUID/PGID; no privileged/capability overrides. Actual API/Nginx processes retain five empty capability sets and no-new-privileges.
conditions.C3: Production-style HTTPS, authentication/authorization, outbound-hostname checks and existing file/preview guards remain enabled; do not expose development servers to untrusted networks.
conditions.C4: Raw snapshots come only from trusted operator-controlled installations with protected provenance and private staging. GNU tar, chown and SQLite processing are not a hostile-input sandbox; checksums do not authenticate origin.
conditions.C5: Keep writable vault access, native memory-corruption/data-loss and denial-of-service residuals explicit. No read-only-root or memory/CPU/PID cap is claimed; daemon containment does not cover separate privileged operator recovery.
conditions.C6: No later than October 12, 2026 00:00 America/New_York, or 30 days after actual acceptance, or candidate freeze/13D, whichever is earliest. Reopen immediately for a relevant vendor fix, changed advisory/caller/input/image/platform, missing evidence or weaker controls. No automatic renewal or extension.
conditions.C7: Approval is local-qualification risk acceptance only, not publication, deployment, a support-policy change, S04/G13-04 closure or Gate 13C/13D acceptance. Hold entries remain unwaived.

explicit_acknowledgments: All five remain potentially applicable; this accepts risk, not a source-precondition exclusion.
Memory corruption, writable-vault/data-loss, information disclosure and process/resource denial of service remain possible; no exploitability or whole-call-graph proof was performed.
The converter naming disagreement and direct-source-review limitation remain explicit.
Exact development images/local qualification only; unchanged October 12-or-earlier deadline. Freeze/rebuild/advisory changes reopen; public release requires its own qualification and decisions.
The accepted impacts include potential native code execution, data loss and disclosure; this is not proof of application exploitability or safety.

scanner_inventory_retained.statement: Retained dated scans, no rescan/filter/suppression. F26 technical resolution does not remove its 28 historical matches.

limits: Only the five named holds move to R, not E or F. Existing exclusion/fix decisions are unchanged.

C1-C7, BusyBox and other earlier caveats, and the October 12-or-earlier deadline remain unchanged; no extension or automatic renewal.
No transfer to a rebuild, architecture, desktop or public candidate. Candidate freeze/13D and C6 triggers reopen decisions.
Earlier proposal/approval JSON is immutable. No new vendor fetch, runtime probe, full suite or image scan accompanies this event.
